description: Read-only index reader of the per-tenant approval store partitions (libs/core/governance/approval-store-location.ts listApprovalPartitions). Assumed only by a process without an active tenant to enumerate the tenant directory names under active/shared/runtime/tenant-approvals/<personal|confidential>/; descendant reads are explicitly denied, so it never reads a record. Each listed tenant is then read as the tenant-bound tenant_approval_store. No write authority.
